meta.name: Make Me Tingle
meta.description: A marketer with traditional views on love and marriage tries to navigate a connection with an adult toy company CEO with different values.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Conservative marketer Yeon-su takes on a former blind date as a new client.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Marketer Yeon-su clashes with her new client, Dal.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A heated argument over love leads to an unexpected move by Dal, leaving a confused Yeon-su reeling.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Yeon-su's event idea takes shape. Meanwhile, Dal shocks her family with an overly blunt remark.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Despite rejecting her date offer, Dal bonds with Yeon-su on assignment -- right as Ji-o drops a surprise confession.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While running a pop-up store in Busan, Yeon-su is forced to confront her true feelings for Dal once and for all.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Met with resistance after confessing her feelings to Dal, Yeon-su proposes a tailor-made relationship just for him.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Dal’s true feelings for Yeon-su begins to surface at an untimely moment.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Standing up to her family's fierce opposition, Yeon-su moves in with Dal instead.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As Loand opens its flagship store, Yeon-su wins her family's approval and begins a real romance with Dal at last.
